name: viraledit
description: Operate the local-first ViralEdit AI video editor from Codex through reversible editing commands, auto-editing, and real browser-side rendering.

interface.shortDescription: Operate ViralEdit's local AI video editor from Codex
interface.longDescription: ViralEdit AI lets Codex inspect and operate a live local ViralEdit editing session. It can build a timeline from clips already loaded in the browser, apply reversible natural-language edit instructions, undo changes, navigate the editor, and render through ViralEdit's existing FFmpeg-WASM pipeline while the footage stays in browser storage.
defaultPrompt: Check my ViralEdit project and tell me what is loaded.
Auto-edit my loaded clips into a punchy Reel.
Tighten the hook, then render the final edit.
